assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome
assertions.quote: Stewart-Treves syndrome is a rare and fatal disease arising from complications of chronic lymphedema

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome
assertions.quote: Stewart and Treves reported a case series describing 6 patients with lymphangiosarcoma in the setting of chronic lymphedema status post mastectomy

assertions.subject: angiosarcoma
assertions.quote: A reported 90% of cases of angiosarcoma associated with lymphedema occur following a mastectomy

assertions.subject: angiosarcoma
assertions.quote: The reported incidence of developing angiosarcoma in patients surviving at least 5 years post radical mastectomy is 0.07% to 0.45%

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome

assertions.subject: Stewart-Treves syndrome
